subject.title: feat(sessions): upstream liveness for adopted catalog sessions

question: Should adopted-session liveness become a generic public Plugin SDK contract now, or remain an internal bundled-provider seam until the broader observer design is settled?
rationale: The patch expands a compatibility-sensitive public API while hard-coding bundled provider kinds and exporting Claude-specific core behavior; mechanical repair cannot safely choose the permanent extension contract.

options.title: Approve a generic plugin contract
options.body: Define opaque provider-owned source and marker payloads, carry agent/source identity end-to-end, and remove Claude/Codex literals from core before merge.

options.title: Keep the seam internal
options.body: Limit this version to bundled-provider registration without new public Plugin SDK exports, then design the external contract separately.

options.title: Pause for the observer design
options.body: Hold this PR and settle the broader contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/104804 before resuming implementation.

recommendation.title: Approve a generic plugin contract
recommendation.body: Define opaque provider-owned source and marker payloads, carry agent/source identity end-to-end, and remove Claude/Codex literals from core before merge.
